issue.title: Bug: test_ntp.py runs ipv6_only twice for mgmt ipv6 only setup

failure.body:

### Description of the bug

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/20292/files#diff-3cfc4b06cc7ecc10aa8d5691584edaa14bb7e07d70319b3a116f50ebd7d5fb07

This PR forces IPv6 for IPv4 test case, but there is a IPv6 test case already, so it unnecessarily runs ipv6 case twice.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run the test_ntp.py in a mgmt ipv6 only setup

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

We should skip IPv4 test case for mgmt ipv6 only setup

resolution.title: Skip ipv4 ntp test for mgmt ipv6 only setup
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Skip ipv4_allowed for mgmt ipv6 only setup because DUT cannot access PTF through IPv4.
PR20292 just forces ipv6 for ipv4 test case, which unnecessarily runs ipv6 case twice.
Fixes #21530

#### What is the motivation for this PR?
PR20292 just forces ipv6 for ipv4 test case, which unnecessarily runs ipv6 case twice.

#### How did you do it?

#### How did you verify/test it?
Run the test in mgmt ipv6 only setup, and it skips ipv4_allowed case and only runs the ipv6_only case.
